items.title: Motorola Razr 2027 leak suggests a January launch is in the cards
items.summary:
Credit: Stephen Radochia / Android Authority 

TL;DR 

A new report says Motorola is planning to launch the Razr 2027 in January. 
 The base model will reportedly adopt the 4-inch cover display featured on the Plus and Ultra. 
 The cover screen’s refresh rate on the base model has been raised from 90Hz to 120Hz. 

With November almost done, there’s only one more month separating us from CES. The January event should be packed to the gills with plenty of surprises. According to a new leak, one of those surprises may be the launch of the Motorola Razr 2027.

Android Headlines reports that Motorola is eyeing early January as a launch date for the Razr 2027 series. Motorola is expected to be a part of Lenovo’s Tech World event at CES, which will be held on January 6. The leak suggests that the Razr announcement could be made during this event. If true, this would move up the launch timeline by a couple of months, as the Razr 2026 was released in May.

items.title: HUAWEI’s new Watch Air is slimmer and lighter than any Pixel Watch or Galaxy Watch ever
items.summary:
Credit: HUAWEI 

TL;DR 

HUAWEI has launched its Watch Air, which is thinner than most modern smartwatches. 
 The Watch Air is only 6.9mm thick and weighs just 29 grams. 
 It runs HarmonyOS 2.0 and works with both Android and iOS. 

HUAWEI might have been forced to stop selling its devices in the US, along with most of the world, but that hasn’t stopped it from pushing the limits of innovation. Earlier today, the company announced its latest foldable, the Mate X8 , with an eye-searingly bright display and a promise that the hinge will last 700,000 folds. The phone even uses levitating magnets under the screen to reduce strain on the folding screen and limit creasing. Another selling point of the Mate X8 is that it’s the slimmest foldable on the market, measuring just 4.2mm when unfolded. To complement the sleek foldable, HUAWEI has also announced a smartwatch significantly slimmer than the latest Pixel or Galaxy Watch devices.

Called the HUAWEI Watch Air, the smartwatch measures only 6.9mm in thickness, excluding the sensor area, and weighs just 27 grams. The Apple Watch inspiration is uncanny, with a rotating crown that doubles as a pressable button along with a flat function button. HUAWEI doubles down by draping the Watch Air in titanium alloy-based finishes. It comes in six color options, including Phantom Night Black, Phantom Silver, Gilded Gold, Floating White, Nebula Apricot, and Spruce Green.
items.t: HUAWEI’s new Watch Air is slimmer and lighter than any Pixel Watch or Galaxy Watch ever

items.title: YouTube Music could finally let you pin your favorite playlists and albums where they belong
items.summary:
TL;DR 

YouTube Music is working on a new feature that could let users pin songs, albums, playlists, and artists directly to their Library for quicker access. 
 The feature is separate from the existing Pin to Speed dial option, which only adds shortcuts to the Home tab. 
 Spotify already offers Library pinning, but it’s unclear how Google’s implementation will work or when it will roll out. 

YouTube Music might finally be addressing one of those little annoyances that can make using a music streaming app more frustrating than it needs to be — having to hunt through your Library to find the music you listen to the most.

We’ve spotted signs of a new pinning feature in the latest YouTube Music Android app (version 9.46.55), and it could let users pin their favorite songs, albums, and playlists directly to the Library tab, making frequently played music much easier to find.
items.t: YouTube Music could finally let you pin your favorite playlists and albums where they belong

 The device lets users view their glucose levels via a connected phone or wearable and offers updates every minute. 
 The Sense G1 costs ~$45 in its home market, but we hope it eventually releases outside China. 

HUAWEI confirmed earlier this month that it would launch its first continuous glucose monitor (CGM) , dubbed the Sense G1. We didn’t get pricing and availability details back then, but the firm has now launched the device in China.

The Sense G1 CGM is the firm’s first Class III medical device and allows users to view their glucose levels via a connected phone or wearable. In fact, you can view your levels on a HUAWEI watch by simply raising your wrist. HUAWEI explains that the CGM offers updates every minute and has a warm-up time of 30 minutes. You can also get alerts for abnormal blood sugar levels, such as high/low levels and emergency low blood sugar. As for measurement accuracy, the manufacturer promises a Mean Absolute Releative Difference (MARD) value of 7.06%.
items.t: HUAWEI’s first continuous glucose monitor is here, costs just under $50

items.title: Spotify outage locks thousands of users out of accounts with widespread login failures
items.summary:
Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority 

TL;DR 

Spotify is experiencing a widespread outage across the US, the UK, Europe, and other regions, with Downdetector logging over 16,000 reports starting around 5:30 AM ET. 
 Affected users on mobile and desktop are being abruptly logged out and blocked by loading screens or false “incorrect username and password” errors, though offline downloads still work if you remain signed in. 
 Spotify confirmed the disruption on X but didn’t share an estimated timeline for a fix. For now, users are advised to avoid resetting passwords or reinstalling the app. 

If you opened Spotify today only to find yourself unexpectedly logged out, you aren’t alone, and your account likely hasn’t been hacked. Following similar service disruptions earlier this fall , Spotify is again suffering from a widespread outage that is locking thousands of listeners out of their accounts.

Reports began spiking around 5:30 AM ET today, with outage-tracking site Downdetector quickly logging more than 16,000 user-submitted incident reports. Affected users across the US, the UK, Europe, and other regions took to X and Reddit to report being abruptly booted from their active listening sessions on both mobile and desktop apps. Attempts to sign back in are largely failing, with users either stuck on loading screens or receiving different authentication errors.
items.t: Spotify outage locks thousands of users out of accounts with widespread login failures

items.title: The Samsung Galaxy A38 tipped to have a downgraded camera, the A58 stays the same
items.summary:
According to the latest rumors, Samsung is planning to cut corners with the Galaxy A38 by using an inferior main camera. Previous reports also point to a downgraded OLED panel.

While on the surface the Galaxy A38 seems to have the same 50MP main camera on the back, a deeper look at the specs reveals a smaller 1/1.95" Sony IMX882 sensor, down from the 1/1.56" Sony IMX906 used in the Galaxy A37.

items.title: RedMagic is the official gaming phone sponsor of the 2026 PUBG Mobile Global Championship
items.summary:
RedMagic has been sponsoring esports in China for a while now, and it's finally taking that to the global stage. Today, the company announced that it's the Official Gaming Phone Sponsor of the 2026 PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC), which is organized by Krafton and Level Infinite.

This year's championship brought together 39 teams from around the world, and the Grand Finals take place in Istanbul, Türkiye, from December 11 to 13. items.title: Honor Magic9 Lite+ tipped to pack a 9,530mAh battery in Europe, more specs surface
items.summary:
The Honor Magic9 Lite+ surfaced on the Google Play Console in October, hinting at a global launch. Now, a new leak reveals its design and key specs, with the phone expected to be a rebranded Honor X9e Pro with slightly different specs.
